item.name: Infinite Void
item.trigger: Use the Infinite Void domain move during Six Eyes.
item.effect: Caught enemies are unable to act for the full duration, though actions already started before the effect can continue.
item.counterplay: Cancel Honored One during windup, break the domain from outside, or kill the caster if trapped inside.
item.clashInvasionRule: Can clash with simultaneous domains. Chimera Shadow Garden can invade the border and disable the stun while the portal is active.
item.notes: Normal domain windup rules apply. One of the sure-hit effects explicitly disabled by Chimera Shadow Garden.

item.name: Malevolent Shrine
item.trigger: Use Malevolent Shrine during King of Curses.
item.effect: Constant slashes hit everyone inside for 2 HP per slash, or 0.5 HP while blocking, for up to 218 HP over the domain.
item.counterplay: Blocking reduces slash damage and prevents slash executions, but the caster can still pressure block. Outside players can break the domain; trapped players need to kill the caster.
item.clashInvasionRule: Can clash with simultaneous domains. Chimera Shadow Garden can invade and disable the slash sure-hit while active.
item.notes: The individual Vessel page confirms the 18s duration, 120s cooldown, and slash values.

item.name: Embodiment of Self Perfection
item.trigger: Use Embodiment of Self Perfection during Essence of the Soul.
item.effect: Targets get a transfiguration meter that drains faster near the caster or when the caster damages them. Emptying the meter kills through transfiguration.
item.counterplay: Cancel the longer windup, break the domain from outside, or kill the caster if trapped. Domain Amplification can nullify the transfiguration, but the meter drain still matters.
item.clashInvasionRule: Can clash with simultaneous domains. Chimera Shadow Garden can invade and disable the transfiguration meter drain while active.
item.notes: You may also see this written as Self-Embodiment of Perfection.

item.name: Authentic Mutual Love
item.trigger: Use Authentic Mutual Love during True Love.
item.effect: Katanas fall inside the domain. Picking one up lets the caster swing a copied technique; landing four katanas unlocks Jacob's Ladder.
item.counterplay: Cancel the longer windup, avoid or punish katana swings, and note that the domain breaks immediately if it catches no enemies.
item.clashInvasionRule: It has no special clash reward. Chimera Shadow Garden does not disable it because there is no sure-hit effect to turn off.
item.notes: Jacob's Ladder can be used once per domain after four landed katana swings and drains health plus awakening progress.

item.name: Time Cell Moon Palace
item.trigger: Use Time Cell Moon Palace during Vengeance.
item.effect: Opponents must follow the 24 FPS rule. Acting other than blocking freezes and shatters their cells, with damage based on movement speed.
item.counterplay: Cancel the windup, stop acting inside except to block, break the domain from outside, or kill the caster if trapped.
item.clashInvasionRule: Can clash with simultaneous domains. Chimera Shadow Garden can invade and disable the frame-shatter sure-hit while active.
item.notes: Casting ends the awakening route and returns the user to their base moveset.

item.name: Idle Death Gamble
item.trigger: Activating Restless Gambler's awakening casts the domain.
item.effect: The caster uses visual moves to trigger Richii scenarios and roll for Jackpot. A normal Jackpot lasts 100s; pity Jackpot lasts 50s.
item.counterplay: The windup is uninterruptible, but anti-team burst can negate the startup stun. The domain can fail if scenarios do not hit Jackpot before it breaks.
item.clashInvasionRule: Winning a domain clash skips the first Richii scenario and immediately grants a 100s Jackpot. Chimera Shadow Garden does not disable it.
item.notes: The important fight timer is the 80s scenario window. Jackpot itself lasts 100s, or 50s if it is the pity Jackpot.

item.name: Deadly Sentencing
item.trigger: Activating Defense Attorney's awakening expands the domain.
item.effect: Everyone inside becomes invulnerable for a trial minigame. Outcomes can return awakening, confiscate moves or held items, unlock Death Penalty, or do both.
item.counterplay: The windup is uninterruptible. Defendants answer the trial choices; six opposing choices immediately end the trial.
item.clashInvasionRule: Winning a domain clash starts Deadly Sentencing with one Judgement Bar segment prefilled. Chimera Shadow Garden does not disable it.
item.notes: Confiscation can remove moves for 90s and items permanently. The domain breaks if no target is caught.

item.name: 0.2 Domain
item.trigger: Use the special during the Six Eyes awakening sequence.
item.effect: Expands Infinite Void over double the normal range for half the normal exposure, then turns into a three-phase rush.
item.counterplay: Can be canceled during windup and sometimes during the rush when i-frames drop. The horizontal rush can be punished after it ends.
item.clashInvasionRule: It has no special clash reward. Chimera Shadow Garden does not disable 0.2 Domain.
item.notes: The Honored One page says the full rush can total 220 damage if every phase connects, then burns the user back to base cooldowns.

item.name: Chimera Shadow Garden
item.trigger: Use Shadow Swarm against a domain border.
item.effect: Creates a shadow tunnel through a domain wall, letting everyone except the Ten Shadows user enter or leave while selected sure-hit effects are disabled.
item.counterplay: Hit Ten Shadows, wait out the HP drain, or force them to close the portal. Maintaining the invasion drains 4 HP per second.
item.clashInvasionRule: Disables Infinite Void, Malevolent Shrine, Embodiment of Self Perfection, and Time Cell Moon Palace while active.
item.notes: Does not affect 0.2 Domain, Idle Death Gamble, Deadly Sentencing, Authentic Mutual Love, or Incomplete Shrine.

item.name: Incomplete Shrine
item.effect: A borderless shrine targets the map with relentless slashes. Each slash deals 3 HP, or 0.5 HP while blocked.
item.counterplay: Strongest Of History is restricted to Roulette, game admin, FSD, or private-server access. The domain lacks a normal border, so outside-wall break counterplay does not apply.
item.clashInvasionRule: Destroys other active domains inside its destruction range. Chimera Shadow Garden does not affect it because it lacks a normal border.
item.availability: Roulette, Game Admin, FSD, and Private Server exclusive
item.notes: Label as restricted/special. It has extreme range, but preparation is required because it can be canceled.
